Interface FastStatsContext

All Known Implementing Classes:
SimpleContext
public sealed interface FastStatsContext permits SimpleContext
Shared FastStats context.

A context provides a shared configuration, token, metrics and optional services for a project. Platforms create contexts by configuring a SimpleContext.Builder.

Since:
0.24.0

      Optional features such as error tracking and feature flags are separate artifacts; add their factory with FastStatsContext.Builder.service(java.util.function.Function).

    • ready

      void ready()
      Performs additional post-startup tasks for configured context services.

      If a ready hook fails, the failure is always logged, regardless of the debug setting, and the context stays not ready, so this method can be called again later.

      Since:
      0.24.0
